title: Alertmanager webhook message
description: Body Alertmanager POSTs to a receiver declared as webhook_configs (payload version 4). Field names and shapes follow notify/webhook/webhook.go (Message) and the serialised model.Alert of the upstream project; scripts/sync_schema.py re-checks the top-level fields against the latest release tag. endsAt carries the Go zero time 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z while an alert is still firing.

commonAnnotations.description: Annotations shared by every alert in the delivery.

commonLabels.description: Labels shared by every alert in the delivery.

externalURL.description: Base URL of the Alertmanager instance that sent the payload.

groupKey.description: Stable identity of the alert group that produced this delivery.

notification_reason.description: Reason Alertmanager attached to this notification (upstream template data field). Releases that do not populate it omit the key, so it is not required here.

receiver.description: Name of the receiver in the Alertmanager configuration.

routeLabels.description: Labels of the route that matched, as rendered by upstream template data. Omitted by releases that do not populate it.

status.description: Group-level status: resolved only when every alert in the group resolved.

truncatedAlerts.description: Alerts dropped because max_alerts was exceeded.

labels.description: Alert identity. incidentd derives the same fingerprint Alertmanager does when the field below is absent.

startsAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp of the first firing evaluation.

endsAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp of the resolution, or 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z while firing. This is the clock incidentd uses for MTTR.

generatorURL.description: Link back to the rule that fired the alert.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the sorted label set, truncated to 8 bytes by Alertmanager.

updatedAt.description: Set by some Alertmanager releases when an alert was updated in flight.
